parts.title: 句子基础
parts.summary: 先找主语和谓语，再判断短语、从句、句型与句子边界。

topics.title: 认识一个完整句子
topics.overview: 一个完整句子通常需要：

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 完整句子的三个条件：一个完整句子通常需要：
主语 Subject：主语是句子中做动作的人、事物或概念。
谓语动词 Verb：谓语动词表示主语的动作或状态，并且通常带有时态或人称变化。
宾语 Object：宾语是动作影响的对象。
补语 Complement：补语用来说明主语或宾语的身份、名称或状态。

examples.english: The student reads the book.
The student = 主语
reads = 谓语动词
the book = 宾语
The teacher explains the rule.
主语：The teacher
examples.note: 主语有时很长。不要把离动词最近的名词自动当成主语。

examples.english: The color of the walls is blue.
examples.note: 真正主语：color；of the walls 只是修饰主语。

examples.english: The room is quiet.
explains 和 is 都是谓语。
The student opened the door.
student = 主语；opened = 谓语；door = 宾语。
The test was difficult.
They called the dog Max.
difficult 说明 test；Max 说明 the dog 的名字。

sections.title: 完整句子的三个条件
lines: 一个完整句子通常需要：
1. 主语：谁或什么在做动作
2. 谓语动词：主语做什么，或处于什么状态
3. 完整意思：读到句号时，意思已经结束
The student reads the book.
The student = 主语
reads = 谓语动词
the book = 宾语

sections.title: 主语 Subject
lines: 主语是句子中做动作的人、事物或概念。
The teacher explains the rule.
主语：The teacher
主语有时很长。不要把离动词最近的名词自动当成主语。
The color of the walls is blue.
真正主语：color；of the walls 只是修饰主语。

sections.title: 谓语动词 Verb
lines: 谓语动词表示主语的动作或状态，并且通常带有时态或人称变化。
The teacher explains the rule.
The room is quiet.
explains 和 is 都是谓语。

sections.title: 宾语 Object
lines: 宾语是动作影响的对象。
The student opened the door.
student = 主语；opened = 谓语；door = 宾语。

sections.title: 补语 Complement
lines: 补语用来说明主语或宾语的身份、名称或状态。
The test was difficult.
They called the dog Max.
difficult 说明 test；Max 说明 the dog 的名字。

topics.title: 短语和从句
topics.overview: 短语是一组单词，但没有完整的“主语 + 谓语”结构，因此一般不能单独成为句子。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 短语 Phrase：短语是一组单词，但没有完整的“主语 + 谓语”结构，因此一般不能单独成为句子。
从句 Clause：从句通常含有主语和谓语。
独立从句 Independent Clause：独立从句可以单独成为完整句子。
从属从句 Dependent Clause：从属从句虽然有主语和谓语，但因为前面有从属连词，不能单独成为完整句子。

examples.english: in the room
after the class
to read the book
running in the park
After the class, the students went home.
the student finished the test
student = 主语；finished = 谓语。
The student finished the test.
Because the student was tired
examples.note: 这句话没有说明“所以发生了什么”。

examples.english: Because the student was tired, he went home.
• because（因为）
• although / though / even though（虽然）
• when / while（当……时）
• after / before（在……之后／之前）
• if / unless（如果／除非）
• since / until（自从／直到）

mistakes.wrong: After the class.
mistakes.right: After the class, the students went home.

sections.title: 短语 Phrase
lines: 短语是一组单词，但没有完整的“主语 + 谓语”结构，因此一般不能单独成为句子。
in the room

to read the book

错误：After the class.
正确：After the class, the students went home.

sections.title: 从句 Clause
lines: 从句通常含有主语和谓语。
the student finished the test
student = 主语；finished = 谓语。

sections.title: 独立从句 Independent Clause
lines: 独立从句可以单独成为完整句子。
The student finished the test.

sections.title: 从属从句 Dependent Clause
lines: 从属从句虽然有主语和谓语，但因为前面有从属连词，不能单独成为完整句子。
Because the student was tired
这句话没有说明“所以发生了什么”。
正确
Because the student was tired, he went home.
常见从属连词：
• because（因为）
• although / though / even though（虽然）
• when / while（当……时）
• after / before（在……之后／之前）
• if / unless（如果／除非）
• since / until（自从／直到）

topics.title: 四种基本句子
topics.overview: 只有一个独立从句。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 简单句：只有一个独立从句。
并列句：含有两个或更多独立从句。
复合句：一个独立从句加至少一个从属从句。
并列复合句：至少有两个独立从句，同时还有从属从句。

examples.english: The boy opened the window.
The boy opened the window, and the girl closed the door.
examples.note: 两边都可以单独成为完整句子。

examples.english: Because it was hot, the boy opened the window.
Because it was hot, the boy opened the window, and the girl turned on the fan.

topics.title: 连接两个完整句子
topics.overview: 先判断空格左右是否都是完整句子。若两边都完整，就必须使用能够连接两个独立从句的结构。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 核心问题：先判断空格左右是否都是完整句子。若两边都完整，就必须使用能够连接两个独立从句的结构。
使用句号：The test was hard. Many students finished it.
使用分号：The test was hard; many students finished it.
公式：完整句；完整句。分号两边必须都能单独成句。
逗号加并列连词：The test was hard, but many students finished it.
公式：完整句，FANBOYS 完整句。
分号加连接副词：The test was hard; however, many students finished it.
公式：完整句；however，完整句。也可以把分号改成句号。

examples.english: The test was hard. Many students finished it.
The test was hard; many students finished it.
because 后面是从属从句，不能放在分号后独立存在。
The test was hard, but many students finished it.
FANBOYS：
The test was hard; however, many students finished it.
常见连接副词：however, therefore, moreover, instead, still, also, as a result。
The test was hard. However, many students finished it.

mistakes.wrong: The test was hard, however, many students finished it.
mistakes.right: The test was hard. However, many students finished it.

topics.title: 常见句子错误
topics.overview: 只用一个逗号连接两个完整句子。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: Comma Splice：逗号拼接：只用一个逗号连接两个完整句子。
Run-on Sentence：粘连句：两个完整句子之间没有正确标点或连接词。
Sentence Fragment：残句：句子缺少主语、谓语或完整意思。

examples.english: The room was cold, so I closed the window.
The room was cold; I closed the window.
The room was cold. I closed the window.
Because the room was cold, I closed the window.

mistakes.wrong: The room was cold, I closed the window.
mistakes.right: The room was cold. I closed the window.

mistakes.wrong: The room was cold I closed the window.
mistakes.right: The room was cold, so I closed the window.

mistakes.wrong: Because the room was cold.
mistakes.right: Because the room was cold, I closed the window.

sections.title: Comma Splice：逗号拼接
lines: 只用一个逗号连接两个完整句子。
错误：The room was cold, I closed the window.
正确：The room was cold, so I closed the window.
正确：The room was cold; I closed the window.
正确：The room was cold. I closed the window.

sections.title: Run-on Sentence：粘连句
lines: 两个完整句子之间没有正确标点或连接词。
错误：The room was cold I closed the window.
正确：The room was cold, so I closed the window.

sections.title: Sentence Fragment：残句
lines: 句子缺少主语、谓语或完整意思。
错误：Because the room was cold.
正确：Because the room was cold, I closed the window.

topics.title: 从属从句和主句
topics.overview: 从属从句，完整句。句首从属从句后通常使用逗号。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 从属从句在前：Because the road was wet, the driver moved slowly.
公式：从属从句，完整句。句首从属从句后通常使用逗号。
主句在前：The driver moved slowly because the road was wet.
Although 和 But 不要重复：错误：Although the test was hard, but the student finished it.
Because 和 So 不要重复：错误：Because it was raining, so we stayed home.

parts.title: 标点与句子边界
parts.summary: 用冒号、破折号和逗号表达正确的句法关系。

topics.title: 冒号 Colon
topics.overview: 冒号用于解释、举例、列出内容或给出具体信息。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 本章要点：冒号用于解释、举例、列出内容或给出具体信息。
完整句加解释：The class had one main rule: students had to arrive on time.
完整句加列表：We need three things: food, water, and time.
冒号规则：冒号前必须是完整句子；冒号后可以是词、短语、列表或完整句。
动词和宾语之间不能加冒号：错误：We need: food, water, and time.
介词和宾语之间不能加冒号：错误：The book is about: art, music, and history.
such as 后通常不用冒号：错误：The shop sells fruit, such as: apples and oranges.

examples.english: The class had one main rule: students had to arrive on time.
We need three things: food, water, and time.
We need food, water, and time.
examples.note: 动词和宾语之间不能加冒号

examples.english: The book is about art, music, and history.
examples.note: 介词和宾语之间不能加冒号

examples.english: The shop sells fruit, such as apples and oranges.
examples.note: such as 后通常不用冒号

mistakes.right: We need three things: food, water, and time.
mistakes.explanation: 动词和宾语之间不能加冒号

mistakes.right: The book is about art, music, and history.
mistakes.explanation: 介词和宾语之间不能加冒号

mistakes.wrong: The shop sells fruit, such as: apples and oranges.
mistakes.right: The shop sells fruit, such as apples and oranges.
mistakes.explanation: such as 后通常不用冒号

topics.title: 破折号 Dash
topics.overview: 学习破折号 Dash的 SAT 核心用法。

levels.label: SAT核心

topics.title: 逗号 Comma
topics.overview: 学习逗号 Comma的 SAT 核心用法。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 句首短语后使用逗号：After the class, the students went home.
非必要信息使用成对逗号：Tom, who lives next door, is a teacher.
必要信息不用逗号：Students who study often get better results.
同位语：Lisa, my best friend, lives in New York.
列表中的逗号：I bought bread, milk, and fruit.
并列形容词：It was a long, difficult test.

parts.title: 动词系统
parts.summary: 检查主谓一致、谓语与非谓语，并根据时间线选择时态。

topics.title: 主谓一致
topics.overview: 单数主语使用单数动词；复数主语使用复数动词。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 基本规则：单数主语使用单数动词；复数主语使用复数动词。
不要被中间的名词影响：The box of books is heavy.
of 后面的名词通常不是主语：The color of the walls is blue.

topics.title: 动词时态
topics.overview: 先建立时间线，再选择动词。不要因为某个时态“看起来高级”就选它。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 做题原则：先建立时间线，再选择动词。不要因为某个时态“看起来高级”就选它。
一般现在时：用于事实、经常发生的动作、现在状态和文章观点。
一般过去时：表示过去已经完成的事情。
现在完成时：结构：has/have + 过去分词。表示过去开始或发生、与现在有关的事情。
过去完成时：结构：had + 过去分词。用于两个过去动作中更早发生的动作。
进行时：结构：be + 动词-ing。强调动作正在进行。
时态保持一致：错误：She opened the door and walks into the room.
根据时间词判断：Since 2020, the school has added five new classes.

examples.english: Water freezes at 0°C.
She walks to school every day.
The writer argues that the rule is unfair.
The class started at nine yesterday.
The team won the game last week.
常见时间词：yesterday, last year, in 2020, two days ago。
Scientists have studied the problem for many years.
She has lived here since 2020.
常见提示：since, for, recently, so far, over the past few years。
By the time the class started, Mia had finished her work.
examples.note: 先完成工作，后开始上课。

examples.english: The students are taking the test.
He was reading when I called.
She opened the door and walked into the room.
Since 2020, the school has added five new classes.
In 2020, the school added five new classes.

mistakes.right: She opened the door and walked into the room.

topics.title: 逻辑连接词
topics.overview: 先忽略选项，判断后一句与前一句是补充、转折、结果、举例、相似、解释还是顺序关系。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 做题方法：先忽略选项，判断后一句与前一句是补充、转折、结果、举例、相似、解释还是顺序关系。
补充：also, moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides
转折：however, yet, still, nevertheless, on the other hand, by contrast
结果：therefore, thus, as a result, so, for this reason
举例：for example, for instance, such as
相似：similarly, likewise, in the same way
顺序：first, next, then, later, finally, meanwhile, before, after
解释：in other words, that is, in fact, more clearly

examples.english: also, moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides
The plan is simple. Moreover, it is cheap.
however, yet, still, nevertheless, on the other hand, by contrast
The test was hard. However, most students passed.
therefore, thus, as a result, so, for this reason
It rained all day. Therefore, the game was stopped.
for example, for instance, such as
Many animals live in groups. For example, wolves often live together.
similarly, likewise, in the same way
Tom enjoys reading. Similarly, his sister spends much of her free time with books.
first, next, then, later, finally, meanwhile, before, after
in other words, that is, in fact, more clearly
The test is optional. In other words, students do not have to take it.

topics.title: 高频 SAT 语法陷阱
topics.overview: 学习高频 SAT 语法陷阱的 SAT 核心用法。

levels.label: SAT核心
levels.focus: 高频 SAT 语法陷阱
content: 陷阱一：离动词最近的名词不一定是主语：The group of students is ready. 主语是 group。
陷阱二：句子很长，不代表主干复杂：The effects of the new rule on students in large schools are clear. 主语 effects；谓语 are。
陷阱三：一个逗号不能连接两个完整句子：错误：The test ended, the students left.
陷阱四：分号两边必须完整：错误：The students left; after the test.
陷阱五：冒号前必须完整：错误：The class includes: reading and writing.
陷阱六：插入信息的标点要成对：正确：The teacher, who came from Canada, works here.
陷阱七：看到复数名词，不要马上选复数动词：Each of the students is ready. 主语是 each。
陷阱八：看到 -ing，不要认为它一定是谓语：The students studying in the room are quiet. 真正谓语是 are。
陷阱九：不要只靠中文翻译判断时态：Since 2020, she has worked here.
陷阱十：修饰语必须和主语匹配：错误：After reading the book, the movie seemed boring. 正确：After reading the book, Mia thought

topics.title: SAT 语法做题步骤
topics.overview: 判断空格左右各有几个独立从句。

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 第一步：找到真正的主语：忽略 of 短语、介词短语和插入语。例：The result of the tests is clear. 主语是 result。
第二步：找到真正的谓语：例：The student sitting by the door is my friend. 真正谓语是 is。
第三步：数完整句子：判断空格左右各有几个独立从句。
第四步：检查标点：逗号是否误连两个完整句？冒号前是否完整？分号两边是否完整？插入标点是否成对？
第五步：检查动词：主谓是否一致？时态是否符合时间线？句子是否缺谓语？
第六步：检查代词：代词指谁？单复数是否一致？应使用主格还是宾格？
第七步：检查修饰语：句首动作是谁做的？修饰语是否靠近正确名词？
第八步：最后检查句意：逻辑、时间、比较对象和前后连贯性是否合理？

topics.overview: 结构

levels.label: SAT核心
content: 本章要点：结构

sections.title: 本章要点
lines: 结构
用途
完整句。完整句。
用句号分开两个独立句。
完整句；完整句。
用分号连接关系紧密的独立句。
完整句，FANBOYS 完整句。
用并列连词连接两个独立句。
完整句；however，完整句。
用连接副词表达转折、因果等关系。
从属从句，完整句。
句首从属从句后通常加逗号。
完整句 + 必要从属从句。
主句在前时，必要从属从句前通常不加逗号。
完整句：解释／例子／列表。
冒号前必须完整。
句首修饰语，逻辑主语 + 谓语。
逗号后必须出现真正执行动作的对象。

topics.overview: 找主语 → 找谓语 → 数完整句 → 判断连接方式 → 检查动词 → 检查修饰语 → 检查代词 → 检查单复数和所有格 → 最后检查句意。

最终总结：SAT 语法的核心不是难词，而是句子结构。遇到任何题目，都按照以下顺序分析：
固定分析流程：找主语 → 找谓语 → 数完整句 → 判断连接方式 → 检查动词 → 检查修饰语 → 检查代词 → 检查单复数和所有格 → 最后检查句意。

sections.title: 固定分析流程
lines: 找主语 → 找谓语 → 数完整句 → 判断连接方式 → 检查动词 → 检查修饰语 → 检查代词 → 检查单复数和所有格 → 最后检查句意。
即使学生只有大约 3000 的基础词汇量，只要能够准确找到句子的主语、谓语和句子边界，就可以处理大多数 SAT 语法题。真正最重要的五个部分是：
1. 独立从句和从属从句
2. 两个完整句子的连接方法
3. 主谓一致
4. 谓语与非谓语
5. 修饰语的位置
掌握这些规则后，SAT 语法将从“凭感觉选答案”变成“按照结构确定答案”。
